summary: Scavvy MAJOR FLOW CHANGE (scan-first + AI room quests) verified end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest passed including all 4 new endpoints — POST /api/environment/analyze (all 5 locations + with-image), POST /api/environment/quests (3-item shape with type/title/hint/difficulty/xp), POST /api/quest/validate (attempt>=2 always success + attempt=1 shape), POST /api/quest/hint (levels 1/2/3, with & without environment). Regressions passed too — /api/ health, /api/adventure/start returns 3 missions, /api/mission/analyze (attempt>=2 always success), /api/mission/easier, /api/adventure/summary (all 4 personalities), /api/voice returns 204 for known & unknown lines (ElevenLabs not configured). Frontend (web preview, 390x844): onboarding -> Home -> START ADVENTURE opens Environment screen with location chips + scan-my-space-button. Selecting loc-Office and tapping scan-my-space-button reaches the Scan screen; scan-web-sample-button proceeds through env analyzing to the Quest Selection screen showing 'Scavvy found 3 sidequests' with quest-card-0/1/2 (type label + title + Easy/Medium + XP). Tapping quest-card-0 reveals Mission with ASK SCAVVY (ask-scavvy-button) and FIND IT (find-it-button); ASK SCAVVY successfully shows a hint-bubble on each of 3 taps and the button disappears at level 3. FIND IT -> web-demo-find-button -> Analyzing -> Success -> next-mission-button labelled 'NEXT SIDEQUEST'. After Q0 completes, quest-card-0 shows COMPLETE badge back on Quest Selection. Same pattern completes Q1 and Q2; after the 3rd success the next-mission-button label correctly changes to 'SEE MY RESULTS' and taps into Adventure Complete (complete-headline). complete-home-button returns to Home. Back navigation verified: env-back returns Home; quests-back (X) is visible on Quest Selection (regression path). Zero pageerrors during the run. Only pre-existing non-blocking RN Web warnings (shadow* / props.pointerEvents deprecated, useNativeDriver on web) carried over from iteration_3/4.

issues: The camera-permission gate on web has no visible back button — only ENABLE CAMERA and 'Use a sample scan' are shown. scan-back is rendered ONLY after the camera view mounts, so on web users can't return to Environment without browser back. Consider showing scan-back on the gate too. Reference: /app/frontend/app/mission/scan.tsx:47-63.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated on RN Web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts and screens using shadow.soft/card/button.
'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing.' Consider Platform.OS gate.

(Optional polish, carried) Migrate theme shadow.* to boxShadow for RN Web.
(Optional polish, carried) Move props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents (GlassTabBar.tsx, camera.tsx, scan.tsx).
(Optional polish, carried) Gate useNativeDriver by Platform.OS !== 'web'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/environment/analyze correctly returns {environment, source} with all six env keys via the ENV_MOCK fallback when the LLM call fails or lacks visibleObjects — good graceful degradation.
server.py /api/environment/quests always returns 3 quests (LLM output is trimmed/padded via q.setdefault) and falls back to _mock_quests(env) with type/title/hint/difficulty/xp — good.
server.py /api/quest/validate enforces attempt>=2 => success deterministically; attempt=1 fallback uses _seed(mission_title, attempt) with 80% success — matches expectations.
server.py /api/quest/hint clamps hint_level to 1..3 and always returns a non-empty hint even without LLM — safe.
quests.tsx uses testID quests-back (X) that resets adventure and routes home — good. quest-card-{i} testIDs are set correctly and 'COMPLETE' badge renders based on completed set.
reveal.tsx correctly hides ask-scavvy-button after 3 hint taps (level 3) and shows hint-bubble on each tap; find-it-button routes into /mission/camera.
scan.tsx: scan-back is only mounted alongside CameraView. On web (permission not granted branch) the gate has no back testID — minor UX gap noted above.
AI service (ai.ts) and ScavvyContext seem to persist scanImages and environment; env-analyze -> env-quests -> validate flow verified end-to-end with real network hops.
